purpose: Increase the BURNED conditional tactical calibration sample under the unchanged opportunity protocol without selecting races by tactical content, outcome, odds, model performance, or finish behavior.

source_scope.meeting: 福島民友杯・リンカイ！磐城平颯来杯
source_scope.source_verification: Official venue pages expose 2日目 (08月07日) replay links for races 1 through 12 and identify the Aug 6-8 meeting as the same FII event.

selection_rule: Take the first six sequential replay races of day 2, R1 through R6, before any tactical frame inspection. Do not skip a race based on visible tactics, expected informativeness, result, odds, candidate behavior, or replay appearance.

regime_screen.rule: Use only objective race/regime header evidence. Any inspected race that is not target-regime remains permanently BURNED but is excluded from the men's numeric denominator.
regime_screen.replacement_rule: Do not automatically fetch or inspect replacement races. If any R1-R6 race is regime-ineligible, stop after the objective screen and write a new prespecified remediation before inspecting later races.

terminal_rule: This batch may only extend the prespecified conditional tactical pilot diagnostics. No pilot rate may become a simulator truth coefficient, model-selection criterion, finish-effect estimate, or real predictive claim at this gate.
